description: Show how the schedule itself ties one item to others: items its descriptor (or another item's descriptor) says are not claimable with it, add-on items performed in association with it, and the neighbouring items filed in the same group and subgroup. Each link quotes the descriptor wording and names the item whose descriptor says it.

item_number.description: An MBS item number, 1 to 6 digits, for example 30445.

name: get_item_relationships
title: Get item relationships
